Kerrie keeps the business running smoothly. From finance and contracts to supplier relationships, she makes sure the team has everything it needs to do its best work for clients.

Darren joins Crucible part-time as Fractional Operations Director, bringing years of experience scaling delivery teams. He looks after process, planning and the way projects move from brief to launch.

Charlie leads our paid media and SEO performance work. She turns data into clear next steps, and has a knack for finding the one change that moves the numbers for our construction and property clients.

Rachel coordinates our content calendar and the many moving parts behind each campaign, from briefing writers to scheduling publication and reporting.
Ellen writes the words on our clients’ websites, in their emails and across their campaigns. She specialises in making technical products and services easy to understand.

title: Web Developer
content:
What you’ll be doing

  • Building custom WordPress themes and blocks from design files
  • Making sure every site is fast, accessible and easy for editors to manage
  • Fixing bugs and handling updates for sites on our Website Support plans
  • Working with SEO and design colleagues on migrations and launches
  • Reviewing code with the rest of the team

What we’ll look for

  • Strong PHP, JavaScript, HTML and CSS (Sass), and experience with WordPress and Advanced Custom Fields
  • An eye for performance and Core Web Vitals
  • Experience with Git and a sensible deployment process
  • A portfolio of sites you are proud of

What we offer

  • A salary of £40,000 to £52,000, depending on experience
  • Remote working anywhere in the UK, with team days in London
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays
  • Equipment of your choice, and a training budget

fields.summary: Build fast, accessible WordPress websites for construction, property and manufacturing clients. You’ll turn designs into clean, well-structured themes and custom blocks, and help keep our hosted sites secure and quick.

title: SEO Content Strategist
content:
What you’ll be doing

  • Researching keywords and search intent for construction, property and manufacturing clients
  • Auditing existing content and finding the gaps competitors are filling
  • Writing clear briefs for our copywriters, and reviewing drafts before they go live
  • Optimising titles, headings, internal links and page structure
  • Reporting on organic traffic, rankings and enquiries each month
  • Working with our developers on technical fixes and site migrations

What we’ll look for

  • Proven experience planning and delivering SEO content programmes
  • Confidence with tools such as Search Console, GA4 and Semrush or Ahrefs
  • Excellent written English and an eye for detail
  • An understanding of how people search with AI tools as well as Google

What we offer

  • A salary of £36,000 to £44,000, depending on experience
  • Hybrid working from our London office, with flexible hours
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, and your birthday off
  • A training budget, and time to use it

fields.summary: Plan and execute content strategies that actually move rankings — keyword research, content gap analysis, on-page optimisation, and briefing writers. You’ll report on organic performance monthly and work with the dev team on technical SEO fixes.

title: Paid Social Manager
content:
What you’ll be doing

  • Planning and executing paid campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and LinkedIn Ads
  • Managing budgets across multiple client accounts, reallocating spend based on performance
  • Running A/B tests on creative, copy, and audience targeting
  • Building and presenting monthly performance reports with clear, actionable takeaways
  • Briefing the content and design teams on creative needs based on what’s converting
  • Keeping an eye on platform updates and testing new ad formats early
  • Working with account managers to make sure paid activity ties back to client goals

What we’ll look for

  • At least 3 years managing paid social for B2B or B2C brands, ideally in an agency
  • Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and LinkedIn Campaign Manager
  • A clear, data-led way of explaining what is working and why
  • Curiosity about construction, property and manufacturing audiences

What we offer

  • A salary of £38,000 to £45,000, depending on experience
  • Hybrid working from our London office, with flexible hours
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, and your birthday off
  • A training budget, and time to use it
  • A friendly team, and social gatherings that are always fun

fields.summary: Run and optimise paid campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and LinkedIn for a mixed portfolio of B2B and B2C clients. You'll own budget allocation, creative testing, and reporting, working closely with the content and design teams to keep ad creative sharp.
